unresolved_layers.boundary: The seventh comprehensive plan began in fiscal 2026. Its annual PDCA method is specified, but a completed current-plan annual progress result has not yet been resolved and prior sixth-plan reports must not be substituted.

quality_boundary: This partial inventory confirms the current 2026–2035 comprehensive plan, its 2026–2030 first midterm implementation layer, the official annual PDCA governance model, fiscal 2026 budget, and fiscal 2024 settlement. It does not substitute sixth-plan reports for seventh-plan progress or promote indicators, projects, budget, settlement, governance, or outcomes to Reviewed, linked, comparable, causal, or policy-achievement status.
next_action: Capture the first published seventh-plan annual PDCA report when available, then review the 30 policy indicators, measure and project mappings, fiscal 2026 budget records, and fiscal 2024 settlement evidence at record level while preserving the sixth-to-seventh plan version boundary.
